name: GHK-Cu
summary: Copper peptide tied to collagen remodeling, wound repair, and follicle biology. Topical evidence only.
lead: GHK-Cu is the copper(II) complex of the tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine (GHK). The tripeptide binds copper strongly, was first isolated from human plasma, and is also found in saliva and urine . In cosmetics it is listed as copper tripeptide-1 and appears in anti-aging, firming and hair-care products .
claims: GHK-Cu in a peptide blend supports skin and hair as well as injury recovery
GHK-Cu is a 'looksmax' peptide that improves skin and appearance
GHK-Cu can deplete copper or cause problems when taken in blends
Injectable GHK-Cu is safe because it is a natural human peptide

name: Matrixyl
summary: Cosmetic signaling peptide marketed for collagen and fine lines.
lead: Matrixyl is the trade name of palmitoyl pentapeptide-4 (Pal-KTTKS, called palmitoyl pentapeptide-3 before 2006), a lipid-modified peptide used in anti-wrinkle cosmetics. It was launched in 2000 as a personal-care active by the French ingredient manufacturer Sederma . The peptide consists of the five amino acids lysine-threonine-threonine-lysine-serine joined to a 16-carbon palmitic acid chain, which is meant to help it cross the lipid structures of the skin .

name: Argireline
summary: The "topical Botox" claim. Evidence is thin.
lead: Argireline, the trade name of acetyl hexapeptide-8 (originally labelled acetyl hexapeptide-3), is a synthetic six-amino-acid peptide used as a topical cosmetic ingredient intended to soften the appearance of expression lines, particularly around the eyes and forehead . It is a short fragment modelled on SNAP-25, a protein that is also a target of botulinum toxin type A, and it is often described in marketing as a "botox-like" or needle-free alternative .

name: SNAP-8
summary: Expression-line cosmetic peptide, same family as Argireline.
lead: SNAP-8, the trade name of acetyl octapeptide-3, is a synthetic peptide used as a topical cosmetic ingredient in serums and eye products marketed for expression lines, particularly on the forehead and around the eyes . It is described as an extended analogue of acetyl hexapeptide-8 (Argireline), built on the same SNAP-25-derived sequence with additional amino acids at one end .
claims: SNAP-8 relaxes facial muscles to give a Botox-like effect on wrinkles
Clinical trials support SNAP-8's wrinkle reduction
An injectable version of SNAP-8 may be worth researching

name: Carnosine
summary: Antioxidant + antiglycation dipeptide studied for skin aging.
lead: Carnosine (beta-alanyl-L-histidine) is a dipeptide of beta-alanine and histidine found at high concentrations in skeletal muscle and brain, and in meat; it is not found in plant foods . It is sold as an oral supplement and added to some skincare products, where it is positioned for antioxidant and anti-glycation effects, meaning protection against the sugar-driven cross-linking of proteins such as collagen .
claims: Carnosine fights glycation and is useful for anti-ageing
Beta-alanine raises muscle carnosine and improves high-intensity performance
Injectable L-carnosine aids recovery
Oral carnosine acts as a general antioxidant supplement in a stack

name: Spironolactone
summary: Antiandrogen used for hormonal acne in the right patients. Also a diuretic.
lead: Spironolactone (brand name Aldactone, among others) is a prescription steroidal medication that blocks aldosterone at the mineralocorticoid receptor and, to a lesser degree, blocks androgen receptors . Its labelled uses are cardiovascular and renal: heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, add-on treatment of hypertension, and oedema in cirrhosis and nephrotic syndrome, with other approved uses including primary hyperaldosteronism and low potassium .
claims: Topical spironolactone prevents steroid-related acne and poor skin texture without affecting hormone levels.
Oral spironolactone helps hair loss caused by DHT.
Spironolactone can reduce water retention caused by growth hormone use.
Spironolactone can cause gynecomastia and lower androgen activity.

name: Clascoterone
summary: Topical antiandrogen approved for acne; being studied for hair loss.
lead: Clascoterone (brand name Winlevi) is a topical androgen receptor inhibitor, a steroid-derived antiandrogen applied to the skin as a 1 percent cream for acne vulgaris . The US Food and Drug Administration approved it in August 2020 for patients aged 12 and older, and the agency considers it a first-in-class medicine . It was developed by Cassiopea, a spin-out of Cosmo Pharmaceuticals .

name: PDRN / Polynucleotides
summary: Salmon-DNA "skin boosters" marketed for regeneration and repair. Formulation-dependent.
lead: Polydeoxyribonucleotide (PDRN) is a mixture of DNA fragments, typically 50 to 1,500 kDa in size, purified from salmon or trout sperm and originally isolated from human placenta in Italy . It is used in injectable and topical "skin booster" or biorevitalisation treatments marketed for skin rejuvenation, scar improvement and recovery after procedures such as laser or microneedling, and it is widely used in Asia as a dermatological biostimulator .

name: Omega-3 (EPA/DHA)
summary: Anti-inflammatory fats relevant to skin, recovery, and general health.
lead: Omega-3 fatty acids are polyunsaturated fats with a double bond three carbons from the methyl end of the chain. The three main types in human physiology are alpha-linolenic acid (ALA), found in some plants, and the long-chain eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA) and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), found in fish, fish oil and algae . EPA and DHA are sold as fish-oil, krill-oil and algal-oil supplements and are also available as prescription omega-3 acid ethyl esters .
claims: Fish oil is a first-line anti-inflammatory supplement
Men need extra DHA because testosterone lowers DHA levels
High-dose DHA reduces sleep apnea events
Omega-3 reduces anxiety

name: Zinc
summary: May calm inflammatory acne; fixes deficiency-related hair shedding.
lead: Zinc is an essential trace element in humans, a cofactor for many enzymes (Grokipedia puts the number above 300) and the second most abundant trace metal in the body after iron . In appearance and skin contexts it is taken as an oral supplement and applied topically, for example in zinc oxide products and acne formulations, and it is discussed for inflammatory acne and for hair shedding linked to deficiency .
claims: Zinc should be supplemented at around 30 to 50 mg per day while using GHK-Cu.
Zinc made a user's voice deeper.
Excess zinc intake requires copper supplementation afterwards.

name: Semaglutide
summary: GLP-1 agonist that kills appetite → major weight loss. The face leans out as the body does.
lead: Semaglutide is a peptide medication that mimics the gut hormone glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and acts as a GLP-1 receptor agonist. Developed by Novo Nordisk, it is sold as Ozempic and Rybelsus for type 2 diabetes and as Wegovy for chronic weight management, and is given as a weekly injection or, in the case of the oral products, a daily tablet . It was approved in the United States in 2017 and in Canada, the European Union and Japan in 2018 .
claims: Semaglutide leans the face as total body fat falls.
Rapid loss can produce "Ozempic face", a hollowed or aged look.
Most weight lost on GLP-1 drugs is muscle unless you resistance-train.
Semaglutide combines well with testosterone therapy and other peptides for physique goals.

name: Tirzepatide
summary: Dual GIP/GLP-1 agonist — the biggest trial weight losses of any approved drug.
lead: Tirzepatide is an injectable peptide that activates both the glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP) receptor and the glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor. Made by Eli Lilly, it is given once weekly and sold as Mounjaro for type 2 diabetes and as Zepbound for chronic weight management and, in the United States, moderate-to-severe obstructive sleep apnea .
claims: Tirzepatide is more effective for fat loss than semaglutide.
It strongly suppresses hunger, making a cut easier.
The weight loss stops showing in the mirror or damages metabolism.
Small doses of the drug are enough for lean users.

name: Liraglutide
summary: Daily-injection GLP-1; older and less potent than semaglutide.
lead: Liraglutide is a glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonist made by Novo Nordisk and given by daily subcutaneous injection. Under the brand name Victoza it is used for type 2 diabetes, and at a higher strength as Saxenda it is used for chronic weight management; it is also available as a generic . It was approved in the European Union in 2009 and in the United States in 2010 .
claims: Liraglutide's shorter action lets users dose around cravings.
It is milder and less potent than semaglutide.
Weight returns after stopping.
Liraglutide spares muscle better than other GLP-1 drugs.

name: Retatrutide
summary: Triple GLP-1/GIP/glucagon agonist in trials. Huge early numbers, still investigational.
lead: Retatrutide (development code LY3437943) is an investigational once-weekly injectable peptide from Eli Lilly that activates three receptors: glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide (GIP), glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and glucagon . It is being studied for obesity, type 2 diabetes, obstructive sleep apnea, knee osteoarthritis and fatty liver disease, and as of the sources reviewed it has no regulatory approval .
claims: Retatrutide outperforms tirzepatide and semaglutide for fat loss.
Low-dose retatrutide gives fat loss with fewer side effects.
It can be run alongside TRT, anabolics and growth hormone for body recomposition.
Research-peptide vials are equivalent to the trial drug.

name: Cagrilintide
summary: Long-acting amylin analogue that suppresses appetite; trialed combined with semaglutide (CagriSema).
lead: Cagrilintide is a long-acting analogue of amylin, a pancreatic hormone co-secreted with insulin that promotes satiety. Developed by Novo Nordisk, it is injected once weekly and is being tested for obesity and type 2 diabetes, both alone and in a fixed combination with semaglutide called CagriSema . It is not approved as a standalone product in the sources reviewed.
claims: Cagrilintide on its own gives strong appetite suppression and weight loss.
Cagrilintide works by mimicking amylin, activating calcitonin and RAMP receptors in the brainstem and slowing gastric emptying.
Leanmaxxing with pharmaceuticals is the most effective way to improve looks.

name: Setmelanotide
summary: MC4R agonist for obesity caused by rare genetic conditions.
lead: Setmelanotide, sold as Imcivree, is a melanocortin-4 receptor (MC4R) agonist given by daily subcutaneous injection. It was invented at Ipsen and developed by Rhythm Pharmaceuticals, and it is approved for obesity caused by rare genetic or acquired disorders of the leptin-melanocortin pathway . It was approved in the United States in November 2020 and in the European Union in July 2021 and the FDA considers it first-in-class .

name: Tesamorelin
summary: GHRH analogue that cuts visceral belly fat in specific HIV patients.
lead: Tesamorelin (brand names Egrifta, Egrifta SV and Egrifta WR) is a synthetic analogue of growth-hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) made by Theratechnologies of Canada. It was approved by the US FDA in November 2010 for reducing excess abdominal fat in HIV-infected adults with lipodystrophy and is given by daily subcutaneous injection .
claims: Tesamorelin plus ipamorelin raises IGF-1 more than other secretagogue blends.
Tesamorelin lowers fat, so GH-related products lower fat in general.
The tesamorelin/ipamorelin blend avoids growth hormone's side effects.
It does not stimulate hunger like some growth-hormone peptides.

name: AOD-9604
summary: Modified GH fragment marketed for fat loss. Human efficacy evidence came up short.
lead: AOD-9604 is a 16-amino-acid synthetic peptide based on residues 176 to 191 of human growth hormone (hGH), with a tyrosine substituted for the N-terminal phenylalanine. It was developed as a potential obesity treatment on the idea that this fragment retains growth hormone's fat-metabolizing action without its other effects .
claims: AOD-9604 burns fat like growth hormone without growth hormone's side effects.
It can be stacked with other peptides such as tesamorelin and IGF-1 LR3 for fat loss.

name: HGH Fragment 176-191
summary: GH fragment promoted for lipolysis. Preclinical only.
lead: HGH Fragment 176-191 (also written hGH frag 176-191 or "frag") is a synthetic peptide that corresponds to the final sixteen amino acids at the C-terminal end of the 191-residue human growth hormone molecule. It is sold online as a research chemical and is discussed in bodybuilding and fat-loss forums as a way to obtain growth hormone's fat-mobilising action without its growth-promoting effects.
claims: Frag 176-191 is the part of growth hormone that burns fat, without the other GH effects
Stacking it with GH secretagogues, clenbuterol or T3 improves fat loss
It is safe because it does not raise IGF-1 or blood sugar

name: 5-Amino-1MQ
summary: NNMT inhibitor marketed for fat metabolism. Preclinical.
lead: 5-Amino-1MQ (5-amino-1-methylquinolinium) is a small-molecule inhibitor of nicotinamide N-methyltransferase (NNMT), an enzyme involved in cellular NAD+ and methyl-group metabolism. It carries a permanent positive charge and is therefore handled as a salt, usually the chloride or iodide. Wikipedia notes that it has been sold as a gray-market weight-loss product, sometimes described as a peptide, although it is an experimental small molecule and not a peptide.
claims: 5-Amino-1MQ burns fat by inhibiting NNMT and raising NAD+
It is a peptide like other injectable research compounds
It is well tolerated

name: Berberine
summary: "Nature's metformin" — modest effects on glucose and lipid metabolism.
lead: Berberine is a yellow quaternary ammonium alkaloid of the benzylisoquinoline class found in the roots, bark and stems of plants such as barberry (Berberis vulgaris), tree turmeric, Oregon grape, goldenseal and Chinese goldthread. Plants containing it have a long history in traditional medicine, and extracts are sold as dietary supplements. Wikipedia notes that, outside China where it is an over-the-counter drug for diarrhea, berberine is not approved as a prescription medicine in any country.
claims: Berberine is "nature's metformin"
It improves nutrient partitioning during a bulk
It reduces body weight and fat
It is a harmless natural supplement

name: L-Carnitine
summary: Shuttles fatty acids into mitochondria; modest and inconsistent weight effects.
lead: L-Carnitine is the biologically active form of carnitine, a quaternary ammonium compound derived from amino acids that carries long-chain fatty acids into mitochondria so they can be oxidised for energy. It is concentrated in skeletal and cardiac muscle. Healthy people, including strict vegetarians, generally make enough of it in the body, and it was first extracted from meat in 1905, which gave it its name from the Latin for flesh.
claims: L-carnitine burns fat by shuttling fatty acids into mitochondria
It improves exercise recovery and performance
Injected carnitine works better than oral
Supplemental carnitine is harmless because it is a natural amino-acid derivative

name: EGCG
summary: Small thermogenic and lipid-metabolism effects. Mixed data.
lead: Epigallocatechin gallate (EGCG, epigallocatechin-3-gallate) is the most abundant catechin in tea, an ester of epigallocatechin and gallic acid. It occurs at high levels in dried green tea leaves (about 7,380 mg per 100 g), white tea and, in smaller amounts, black tea, and is sold in concentrated form in many dietary supplements.
claims: EGCG is a fat burner best taken pre-workout
EGCG inhibits myostatin and could help build muscle
More EGCG is better and supplements are safe

name: Capsaicin
summary: Chili compound; slight nudges to energy expenditure and appetite.
lead: Capsaicin (8-methyl-N-vanillyl-6-nonenamide) is the main pungent compound in chili peppers. It and related capsaicinoids are produced by plants of the genus Capsicum, likely as a deterrent to mammals and fungi, and it causes a burning sensation on contact with tissues in mammals.

name: Creatine monohydrate
summary: The most proven supplement in existence: strength, size, high-intensity performance.
lead: Creatine is an organic compound that helps regenerate adenosine triphosphate (ATP) in muscle and brain tissue. Its phosphorylated form, phosphocreatine, donates a phosphate group to ADP in a reaction catalysed by creatine kinase. The body makes it from glycine and arginine in the liver and kidneys, and about 95 percent of total body creatine sits in skeletal muscle. Creatine monohydrate is the most widely sold supplemental form.
claims: Creatine is a steroid or cheating
Creatine causes hair loss by raising DHT
Creatine damages the kidneys
Creatine builds strength and muscle

name: Whey protein
summary: Fast-digesting protein loaded with leucine for muscle protein synthesis.
lead: Whey protein is a mixture of proteins isolated from whey, the liquid by-product of cheese making. Its main components are beta-lactoglobulin, alpha-lactalbumin, serum albumin and immunoglobulins, and it is sold mainly as a powdered protein supplement in concentrate, isolate and hydrolysate forms.
claims: Whey helps build muscle
Whey aids fat loss
Whey causes acne
Whey harms kidneys and liver

name: Leucine
summary: The amino acid that triggers muscle growth signaling (mTOR).
lead: Leucine is an essential branched-chain amino acid (BCAA): the human body cannot make it, so it must come from dietary protein such as meat, dairy, soy and legumes . Along with isoleucine and valine it is one of the three BCAAs, and it is sold both as a stand-alone powder and as an ingredient in BCAA, essential amino acid and pre- or intra-workout products.
claims: Leucine 'turns on' mTOR and is the key trigger for muscle growth
Soy protein is inferior to whey because of lower leucine content
Adding leucine to a pre- or post-workout drink offers extra benefit
Leucine alone, not BCAA blends, is what matters (or BCAAs are not needed if protein is adequate)

name: Beta-alanine
summary: Buffers muscle acid for better high-rep performance. The tingles are normal.
lead: Beta-alanine is a naturally occurring non-proteinogenic amino acid in which the amino group sits on the beta carbon (IUPAC name 3-aminopropanoic acid) . It is the rate-limiting precursor of carnosine, a dipeptide stored at high concentration in skeletal muscle, where it acts as an intramuscular buffer . As a supplement it is sold as a powder or capsule and is a staple ingredient of pre-workout formulas.
claims: Beta-alanine raises muscle carnosine and so lets you do more work at high intensity
The tingling is a sign it is working
Beta-alanine improves single-effort maximal strength
Chronic use could oversaturate carnosine and slow metabolism or cause fatigue

name: HMB
summary: Leucine metabolite studied for reducing muscle breakdown. Mixed results.
lead: HMB (beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate) is a metabolite of the essential amino acid leucine that the body produces naturally; roughly 5 percent of dietary leucine is converted to it . Two supplement forms have been studied, a calcium salt (HMB-Ca) and a free acid (HMB-FA) .
claims: HMB rivals anabolic steroids
HMB helps you recover faster and handle more training volume
HMB preserves muscle during illness, bed rest or ageing
HMB is a safe, low-risk supplement

name: Citrulline malate
summary: Nitric-oxide precursor for pump and blood flow; performance data mixed.
lead: Citrulline malate (CM) is a supplement that combines the amino acid L-citrulline with malic acid. Citrulline is a non-essential alpha-amino acid and a key intermediate in the urea cycle, the pathway mammals use to convert ammonia to urea; it is also a byproduct of nitric oxide production from arginine . Its name comes from citrullus, the Latin word for watermelon, from which it was first isolated in 1914 .
claims: Citrulline malate boosts nitric oxide, pump and blood flow
It improves endurance and reps in the gym
Citrulline helps blood pressure and erectile function alongside tadalafil
Citrulline is gentler on mood than arginine
